d:
Stand-up comedian Yash Maheshwari has sparked a major controversy over his remarks about sindoor, married women in Bihar and Lord Hanuman in his comedy special, 'Morally Questionable'. Following widespread backlash on social media, the comedian deleted the video and issued a public apology.
Patna Police has reportedly registered an FIR against Yash Maheshwari. His other remarks concerning women in Bihar, Haryana and domestic violence have also drawn sharp criticism.
